<answer>
To wash wine glasses properly, start by using hot water and mild detergent to clean the outside of the glass. If there are stubborn wine residues, use baking soda to dissolve them by mixing a small amount of soda with hot water and letting it sit in the glass for a few minutes. For cleaning the inside of the glass, use a stemware brush with soft-foam bristles. Rinse thoroughly with hot water and dry the glasses with a smooth lint-free cloth. To avoid damage, wash one wine glass at a time, use a small amount of detergent only where it's needed, and cradle the bowl of the glass in one hand while washing to protect the stem.
</answer>
